name: Cryonic-Vanguard
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait perpetual storm systems, and everything the light never reaches.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
